욥기 38:1.content: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

욥기 38:2.content: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

욥기 38:3.content: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

욥기 38:4.content: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

욥기 38:5.content: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

욥기 38:6.content: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

욥기 38:7.content: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

욥기 38:8.content: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

욥기 38:9.content: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

욥기 38:10.content: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

욥기 38:11.content: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

욥기 38:12.content: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

욥기 38:13.content: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

욥기 38:14.content: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

욥기 38:15.content: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

욥기 38:16.content: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

욥기 38:17.content: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

욥기 38:18.content: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

욥기 38:19.content: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

욥기 38:20.content: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

욥기 38:21.content: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

욥기 38:22.content: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

욥기 38:23.content: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

욥기 38:24.content: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

욥기 38:25.content: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

욥기 38:26.content: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

욥기 38:27.content: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

욥기 38:28.content: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

욥기 38:29.content: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

욥기 38:30.content: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

욥기 38:31.content: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

욥기 38:32.content: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

욥기 38:33.content: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

욥기 38:34.content: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

욥기 38:35.content: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?

욥기 38:36.content: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

욥기 38:37.content: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

욥기 38:38.content: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

욥기 38:39.content: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

욥기 38:40.content: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

욥기 38:41.content: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
